image_description: A street-level view of a bakery storefront featuring a large, multi-pane glass display window filled with various baked goods. Above the window is a decorative tiled facade and a blue sign with white cursive text. To the right, a person in a yellow shirt and blue jeans stands facing a wall mural or poster. The building exterior appears to be brick above the shop front.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the blue sign is stylized but largely illegible and nonsensical, characteristic of AI-generated text that mimics script without forming coherent words.
The individual baked items lack distinct texture detail and appear somewhat smudged or fused together, lacking the crisp edges expected of real photography.
The person's feet blend slightly into the pavement, and the shoe geometry is indistinct, suggesting minor structural ambiguity in the lower limbs.
The vertical mullions of the window show slight waviness and inconsistent thickness, deviating from the rigid straight lines expected in architectural elements.

focus_areas: Legibility and semantic correctness of the text on the blue sign.
Structural integrity and straightness of the window frames/mullions.
Distinctness and separation of individual baked goods in the display.
Anatomical correctness of the person standing on the right, especially feet and hands.
Consistency of lighting and reflections in the glass display window.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the sign; if it is gibberish, this is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, scrutinize the window frames for any warping or melting, as architectural lines should be straight. Check if the baked goods look like distinct objects or a textured smear.
